completeCurrentRecord.name: Quickened Thought

sourceObject.name: Quickened Thought
sourceObject.description: Your mind outpaces the tick of Aethel's clocks—ideas arrive finished in the Temporal Tower's shadow, as if tomorrow's spell were already written in today's breath. Prestige lineage: Chronomancer. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Intelligence 15+, Arcane Calculus or Temporal Theory
sourceObject.effect: You gain +2 to initiative and advantage on concentration saves while holding a readied spell. Once per short rest, you may cast a spell of 2nd level or lower as a bonus action; if you do, you cannot take a reaction until the start of your next turn. When you roll initiative, you may bank one cantrip cast—release it on any later turn in the encounter without spending an action.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require INT 15 and (Arcane Calculus OR Temporal Theory). NEW resolve the grammatical scope as+2 initiative AND concentration-saveadvantage only while actually holding a readied spell; initiative is not recomputed later. Once SR/LR change an actually available normalActionspell of actualrank 0–2 to BA, paying every normal cost. From commitment until your next regular start you cannot commit anyReaction, even if the spell is countered; existing stacked Reactions finish. Separately, at first legitimate initiative roll of a real encounter, you may immediately prepare one legal normalActioncantrip as a non-action: pay components/independent RP/history, establish held concentration, open interruption, and use the same single pendingReady slot. NEW release that cantrip once withoutAction on one of your later own regular turns in that encounter, retaining actual concentration until then; target legality rechecks at release. This replaces any oldReady, ends at encounter end or lostconcentration, cannot be banked again by reroll/reentry, and shares the free-stored-release cap of one per owner/numbered round with Arcane Calculus. No extra cast/copy/proc at release.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Both passivebonuses scoped to actual hold, one initial cantrip preparation and persistent no Reaction debt.
submittedWorkedCases: A banked cantrip paid at initiative can release on your second regular turn withoutAction if concentration survives.
Using theBAspell branch then leaves noReaction for Counterspell until the real next regular start.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep the source later-any-turn banked cantrip release rather than own-turn-only; it is between events, concentration-bound and shared-cap, not a free interrupt or extra turn.
